title.value: An Act To enact R.S. 40:1615, relative to fire fighting foam; to provide for the discharge of Class B fire fighting foam containing fluorinated organic chemicals; to provide for exceptions; to provide for definitions; to provide for applicability; to provide for an effective date; and to provide for related matters.
title.provenance: AN ACT To enact R.S. 40:1615, relative to fire fighting foam; to provide for the discharge of Class B fire fighting foam containing fluorinated organic chemicals; to provide for exceptions; to provide for definitions; to provide for applicability; to provide for an effective date; and to provide for related matters.

location.provenance: 2021 Regular Session, House Bill No. 389, Prefiled pursuant to Article III, Section 2(A)(4)(b)(i) of the Constitution of Louisiana.

status.provenance: This Act shall become effective upon signature by the governor or, if not signed by the governor, upon expiration of the time for bills to become law without signature by the governor, as provided by Article III, Section 18 of the Constitution of Louisiana.

date.provenance: The document does not explicitly provide an effective date, only stating 'On and after January 1, 2022' for the prohibition and 'This Act shall become effective upon signature of governor or, if not signed by the governor, upon expiration of the time for bills to become law without signature'.

pfas_definition.provenance: PFAS chemicals means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom, including perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances, and designed to be fully functional in Class B fire fighting foam formulations.

type.provenance: Prohibits the discharge or use of Class B fire fighting foam that contains intentionally added PFAS chemicals

who.provenance: no person shall discharge or otherwise use Class B fire fighting foam that contains intentionally added PFAS chemicals

action.provenance: such discharge or other use... unless discharged under either of the following conditions

value: Class B fire fighting foam containing intentionally added PFAS chemicals
products.provenance: Class B fire fighting foam that contains intentionally added PFAS chemicals

value: Discharge or use in fire prevention or in response to an emergency fire fighting operation
Discharge or use for training or testing purposes at a facility with containment, treatment, and disposal measures
exceptions.provenance: Such discharge or other use occurs in fire prevention or in response to an emergency fire fighting operation. Such discharge or other use is for training or testing purposes which occurs at a facility that has implemented containment, treatment, and disposal measures to prevent uncontrolled releases of such Class B fire fighting foam into the environment.

currently_unavoidable.provenance: The document does not mention 'currently unavoidable use'

intentionally_added.provenance: PFAS chemicals... unless discharged under either of the following conditions: (1) Such discharge or other use occurs in fire prevention or in response to an emergency fire fighting operation. (2) Such discharge or other use is for training or testing purposes which occurs at a facility that has implemented containment, treatment, and disposal measures to prevent uncontrolled releases of such Class B fire fighting foam into the environment.
